title: Grateful Dead Live at Providence Civic Center on 1982-04-15

ai_review.summary: Decent unknown‑source recording of a solid Dead show, with a standout performance of Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers praise the concert, noting that the Morning Dew was the highlight and that the overall vibe made them want to listen to the entire set. While no specific technical details are given, the fact that listeners streamed it, burned it to CD and kept it in their car suggests a listenable, well‑balanced capture. The show is regarded as enjoyable and energetic despite lacking detailed commentary on individual band members.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (4‑5) and enthusiastic comments indicate a strong musical performance; lack of technical criticism implies the recording is at least good, yielding an overall rating in the low‑to‑mid 4‑star range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on sound clarity or mix; listeners found it suitable for streaming and CD burning, implying a reasonably clear capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers felt the show flowed well enough to keep them listening through the entire set.
